DIRECTION RULES
D01 [other, all scenes] Visual Style: Realistic Sri Lankan cinematic drama, natural lighting, authentic environments and emotionally grounded performances.
D02 [editing, all scenes] Scene Structure: Fewer, longer scenes with multiple camera shots and continuous dramatic action.
D03 [editing, scene 1] A romantic montage follows: Anudi visits Kasun after work. Kasun prepares her favourite tea. They spend time talking and laughing. Anudi helps him arrange food containers. Kasun walks with her to her car. They exchange smiles before saying goodbye.
D04 [editing, scene 1] A sequence of connected moments shows his struggle. He visits a bank and discusses a business loan. He sits with a potential investor and explains his business plan. He makes phone calls to friends asking for financial support. He reviews his business documents and calculations late at night. Each attempt ends in disappointment. The bank cannot offer the required support. The investor doesn't believe the small business can handle such a large order. His friends are unable to help.
D05 [sound, scene 3] Silence.
D06 [lighting, scene 5] The interior has warm lighting, wooden tables and Sri Lankan-inspired design.
D07 [lens, scene 5] The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the restaurant and its customers.
D08 [editing, scene 5] FINAL TEXT ON SCREEN: "සමහර ආදර කතාවලට සල්ලි ඕනේ නෑ. තමන්ගේ හීන විශ්වාස කරන කෙනෙක් හිටියම ඇති."
D09 [other, all scenes] Kasun maintains the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type throughout.
D10 [other, all scenes] Anudi maintains the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type throughout.
D11 [other, all scenes] Anudi's father maintains the same appearance throughout.
D12 [other, place L03] Kasun's three-wheeler remains the same vehicle.

E02-S04 SCENE 04 — KASUN'S DETERMINATION AND THE BIG OPPORTUNITY
172: changes.
173: The supermarket order requires a major investment.
174: He needs Rs. 2 million.
175: He looks at the numbers again.
176: He doesn't have enough money.
177: Anudi notices his silence.

SCENES TO BREAK DOWN
=== E03-S01 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
182: SCENE 01 — THE STRUGGLE
183: Location: Kasun's workspace and Colombo – Different locations
184: Duration: 0.54 minutes
185: Kasun is determined to secure the Rs. 2 million needed to expand his business.
186: A sequence of connected moments shows his struggle.
187: He visits a bank and discusses a business loan.
188: He sits with a potential investor and explains his business plan.
189: He makes phone calls to friends asking for financial support.
190: He reviews his business documents and calculations late at night.
191: Each attempt ends in disappointment.
192: The bank cannot offer the required support.
193: The investor doesn't believe the small business can handle such a large order.
194: His friends are unable to help.
195: Finally, Kasun returns to his small workspace.
196: He sits alone at the desk, looking at the supermarket order and the financial calculations.
197: He realizes that his biggest opportunity may disappear because he cannot find the money.

=== E03-S02 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
198: SCENE 02 — ANUDI'S SUPPORT
199: Location: Anudi's family home – Bedroom
200: Duration: 0.38 minutes
201: Anudi sits alone in her bedroom.
202: She looks at a photograph of herself and Kasun.
203: Her phone rings.
204: It is Kasun.
205: Anudi: "කොහොමද කසුන්? වැඩේ හරියනවද?"
206: Kasun: "තාම හරියට විසඳුමක් නෑ අනුදි. බැංකුවෙන්වත් investor කෙනෙක්ගෙන්වත්
207: උදව්වක් ලැබුණේ නෑ."
208: Anudi sounds concerned.
209: Anudi: "හැමදේම හරියයි කසුන්. ඔයා උත්සාහය අතාරින්න එපා."
210: Kasun smiles slightly.
211: Kasun: "මම උත්සාහ කරනවා අනුදි."
212: They end the call.
213: Anudi looks worried but continues believing in him.

=== E03-S03 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
214: SCENE 03 — AN UNEXPECTED OFFER
215: Location: Kasun's small workspace
216: Duration: 0.63 minutes
217: Kasun is reviewing business documents at his small desk.
218: Someone arrives.
219: It is Anudi's father.
220: Kasun stands up respectfully.
221: Kasun: "ආයුබෝවන් සර්. වාඩිවෙන්න."
222: The father sits down.
223: He looks around the small workspace.
224: He notices the business documents, food containers and calculations on the table.
225: He takes an envelope from his bag and places it on the table.
226: Kasun looks at it.
227: Father: "මේකේ රුපියල් මිලියන දෙකක් තියෙනවා."
228: Kasun looks surprised.
229: He opens the envelope and sees the cheque.
230: Kasun: "බොහොම ස්තූතියි සර්. මේක මට ලොකු උදව්වක්."
231: The father looks directly at him.
232: Father: "හැබැයි එක කොන්දේසියක් තියෙනවා."
233: Kasun looks up.
234: Father: "ඔයා මගේ දුවගෙන් ඈත් වෙන්න ඕනේ."
235: Silence.
236: Kasun's smile disappears.
237: He looks at the cheque and then at Anudi's father.

=== E03-S04 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
238: SCENE 04 — THE CHOICE
239: Location: Same workspace
240: Duration: 0.54 minutes
241: Kasun remains silent for a moment.
242: He looks at the cheque.
243: He knows how much his business needs this money.
244: He looks at the business documents on the table.
245: Then he slowly pushes the cheque back toward Anudi's father.
246: Kasun: "සර්... මට ඕනේ අනුදිව මිසක් ඔයාගේ සල්ලි නෙවෙයි."
247: The father looks surprised.
248: Kasun takes a breath.
249: Kasun: "මගේ ව්‍යාපාරය මමම ගොඩනගා ගන්නම්. ඒත් මගේ ආදරේ සල්ලිවලට අතාරින්න
250: මට බෑ."
251: He stands up.
252: Kasun: "මට සමාවෙන්න සර්."
253: Kasun respectfully walks away.
254: The father remains seated.
255: He looks at the cheque and then around the small workspace.
256: For the first time, he begins to question his judgment about Kasun.

=== E03-S05 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
257: SCENE 05 — A DREAM COMES TRUE
258: Location: KASUN'S Restaurant – Day
259: Duration: 0.83 minutes
260: Several months later.
261: A modern but welcoming Sri Lankan restaurant is ready to open.
262: The restaurant sign reads:
263: KASUN'S — SRI LANKAN FOOD & COFFEE
264: The restaurant is busy.
265: Staff members are serving customers.
266: The interior has warm lighting, wooden tables and Sri Lankan-inspired design.
267: Kasun, now dressed in smart-casual clothing, stands proudly near the entrance.
268: Anudi stands beside him.
269: She looks around the restaurant and smiles.

scenes.title: Funding attempts
